feature_cannot_determine.why: A4 requires size and angle on every chamfer; cecad.inspect has no chamfer classifier — a chamfer is a planar face bridging two faces at an angle and nothing here identifies one
feature_cannot_determine.settled_by: a chamfer classifier in cecad.inspect (planar face whose two neighbours meet it at equal angles), or the builder declaring its chamfers in the part record

feature_cannot_determine.why: A4 requires thickness, height and pitch on every rib; nothing here groups faces into a rib
feature_cannot_determine.settled_by: a rib classifier (parallel thin prisms standing off a wall), or the builder declaring its rib pitch

feature_cannot_determine.why: A4 requires every draft angle; no face here is tested for draft against a pull direction
feature_cannot_determine.settled_by: a pull direction on the part record, then the angle of every planar face to it

feature_cannot_determine.why: A4 requires every step and shoulder; nothing here classifies a shoulder between two coaxial diameters or two parallel faces
feature_cannot_determine.settled_by: a step classifier, or the section views declaring their stations

feature_cannot_determine.why: A4 requires every surface that mates with another part, with the mating part named by its triad ref; the mates live in ce-assemblies/*/joints.json and are not read here
feature_cannot_determine.settled_by: reading this part's joints out of the assemblies that use it and matching each mate to a face

feature_cannot_determine.why: A4 wants a wall thickness at every distinct station; only the thinnest wall is measurable off the solid without a station list
feature_cannot_determine.settled_by: the drawer declaring the section stations it dimensions, or a section per shell region
